snippet.title: Mixtape - Official Accolades Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Accolades Trailer for Mixtape, a music-centric adventure walking simulator developed by Beethoven and Dinosaur. Players will step into the role of three friends on one action-packed final night filled with adventure and a soundtrack for the ages. Listen to a soundtrack of generations in Mixtape, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
